reigns.note: King who built the treasury and begot Orchomenus the eponym; Apollonius makes him son of Aeolus instead (Arg. 3.1077).
King of the Minyans, wounded in a precinct of Poseidon by a Theban charioteer — the grievance that set Erginus' tribute on Thebes.
Son of Clymenus, who sent heralds to Thebes for the tribute until Heracles routed the Minyans and ended their exaction.

After Trophonius was swallowed in the Lebadeian grove, Pausanias says the kingdom of Orchomenus passed to the sons of Ares and Astyoche — the same pair Homer leads to Troy from Orchomenus and Aspledon.
